connectors.name: Left header
connectors.orderNote: No printed position numbers; vertical row, started at the end closest to the USB-C connector (top of image). Square bottom pad not treated as a pin-1 mark (rule 9).

connectors.name: Right header
connectors.orderNote: No printed position numbers; vertical row, started at the end closest to the USB-C connector (top of image). Square bottom pad not treated as a pin-1 mark (rule 9).

unreadable: left-header positions 5-6 (B01, B02) and right-header position 7 (ALD01): O and 0 cannot be told apart in this font; recorded with 0 per rule 5.
right-header positions 1-6: only tiny silkscreen labels beside the holes (beside the SD card slot), too blurred to read; partial impressions only (several look like IO1x).

right-header positions 7-15: tiny silkscreen labels next to the holes (apparently GPIO names, e.g. near SDA something like IO8) are too blurred to read reliably and were not transcribed; the boxed labels were used.
notes: Labels read from the boxed silkscreen labels on the board in the main photo; on the left header the tiny per-hole silkscreen repeats the boxed names. QWIIC connectors and other connectors in the top inset photo have no legible per-pin labels and are skipped.
uncertain: right-header position 13: the first character is hidden by a mounting hole; visible "?XD" recorded as TXD by inference (it follows RXD).
right-header position 11: boxed label looks like "JO15" (first glyph has a hook); recorded as IO15, which the tiny silkscreen beside the hole appears to show.

right-header positions 7-15: the tiny per-hole silkscreen appears to give different (GPIO) names than the boxed labels (e.g. SDA hole), so the boxed label may not be the GPIO name rule 5 prefers; unreadable at this resolution.
